objective: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to make an attempt to head north. If you can finish that, assure that the locker is opened. Having pulled open the locker, recover the cabbage from the locker. After that, eat the cabbage. And if you do that, you're the winner!

quests.desc: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, take a trip north. And then, open the locker in the vault. And then, recover the cabbage from the locker. After that, eat the cabbage. And if you do that, you're the winner!
